description: 따뜻한 수채화풍 그림책 삽화. 부드러운 붓 자국, 은은한 흙빛 색감.
promptPrefix: Warm watercolor picture-book illustration with soft brush texture and a muted earthy palette. Wide establishing composition, square format, calm and reverent mood.
promptRules: Rules: Paint only what the scene describes. Do not add people, animals, land, shores, plants, buildings, sun, moon or stars unless the scene mentions them, and leave out everything the scene says is absent. God is never shown as a figure or a face. When the scene mentions people, keep them small and distant, modestly covered by foliage or shadow. No violence or gore. No text, letters, captions, borders, frames or watermarks.
